# WebCode IDE

> WebCode is an instant, client-side web IDE and multi-language execution engine running 100% in the browser via WebAssembly (WASM), Web Workers, and sandboxed iframes. Zero installation, zero cloud compute, private and offline-capable.

## Core Compilers & Runtimes

- [Python Online Compiler](https://webcode.xicae.dev/python-online-compiler/): Python 3.12 via Pyodide with micropip package support (NumPy, Pandas, Matplotlib, SciPy, Scikit-Learn).
- [JavaScript Online Compiler](https://webcode.xicae.dev/javascript-online-compiler/): Isolated Web Worker execution with dynamic ESM CDN package loading.
- [TypeScript Online Compiler](https://webcode.xicae.dev/typescript-online-compiler/): TypeScript runtime with instant client-side transpilation and type-checking.
- [SQLite Online Compiler](https://webcode.xicae.dev/sqlite-online-compiler/): Full SQLite 3 in WebAssembly with Northwind and Chinook sample databases.
- [C++ Online Compiler](https://webcode.xicae.dev/cpp-online-compiler/): C++ WebAssembly runtime with standard I/O streaming.
- [HTML5/CSS3/JS Live Editor](https://webcode.xicae.dev/html-css-js-editor/): Sandboxed real-time live preview with DOM rendering.
- [Lua Online Compiler](https://webcode.xicae.dev/lua-online-compiler/): Lua 5.4 in-browser VM.
- [Ruby Online Compiler](https://webcode.xicae.dev/ruby-online-compiler/): Ruby 3.3 WebAssembly engine.
- [Bash / Shell Online](https://webcode.xicae.dev/bash-shell-online/): Unix shell emulation in the browser.
- [JSON Formatter & Validator](https://webcode.xicae.dev/json-formatter-validator/): Fast deterministic JSON beautifier and validator.
- [Markdown Live Editor](https://webcode.xicae.dev/markdown-live-editor/): Real-time CommonMark editor with GitHub Flavored Markdown preview.

## Popular Library Sandboxes

- [Python NumPy Sandbox](https://webcode.xicae.dev/python-online-compiler/numpy/): In-browser array calculations and linear algebra.
- [Python Pandas Sandbox](https://webcode.xicae.dev/python-online-compiler/pandas/): In-browser DataFrame analytics with zero upload.
- [Python Matplotlib Sandbox](https://webcode.xicae.dev/python-online-compiler/matplotlib/): Client-side chart and plot generation.
- [JavaScript Axios Sandbox](https://webcode.xicae.dev/javascript-online-compiler/axios/): Test HTTP requests directly in the browser sandbox.
- [SQLite Northwind Dataset](https://webcode.xicae.dev/sqlite-online-compiler/northwind/): Preloaded relational schema with orders, customers, and products.

## Algorithm Reference & Implementations

- [Binary Search](https://webcode.xicae.dev/python-online-compiler/algorithms/binary-search/): O(log n) search algorithm in Python.
- [Quick Sort](https://webcode.xicae.dev/python-online-compiler/algorithms/quick-sort/): Divide-and-conquer sorting in Python.
- [Merge Sort](https://webcode.xicae.dev/python-online-compiler/algorithms/merge-sort/): Stable O(n log n) sorting algorithm.
- [Dijkstra Shortest Path](https://webcode.xicae.dev/python-online-compiler/algorithms/dijkstra/): Graph shortest path algorithm.
- [Kadane's Algorithm](https://webcode.xicae.dev/python/algorithms/kadane-algorithm/): Maximum subarray sum in O(n) time.

## Developer Suite & Integration

- [WebCode IDE Workspace](https://webcode.xicae.dev/editor/): Full IDE with file explorer, multi-tab editing, and OPFS storage.
- [Projects Dashboard](https://webcode.xicae.dev/projects/): Local workspace projects manager.
- [Xicae MCP & API Gateway](https://api.xicae.dev/docs): Deterministic code execution recipes, AST parsing, and MCP tools for AI agents.
